Hi Samira —

Thanks for the form — looks good. Quick answers below and a couple of next steps to get you live: 

Payment rails supported
- ACH (preferred for US vendors) and domestic wire (for same-business-day settlement).
- International wires: yes, but those require an additional remittance field and SWIFT/BIC.

DocuSign vs portal
- For B2B security we require either: (a) DocuSign envelope with bank details (recommended), or (b) upload a voided check to our secure vendor portal. DocuSign reduces back-and-forth.

PO & invoice matching
- Please include PO in the invoice number field using this format: PO-<6 digits>-<client-code>. Example: PO-000487-RI.
- Remittance file is CSV with columns: invoice_number, invoice_date, po_number, amount, remit_note. I'll attach our sample remittance_template.csv for your AP team.

Next steps (proposed timeline)
1) Ben uploads a voided check or signs the DocuSign envelope (today).
2) Our Finance team validates micro-deposits (1–2 business days).
3) We enable ACH for your vendor profile and confirm go-live.

I've attached the remittance template and a sample PO/invoice mapping. I'm also attaching a short checklist for the procurement team.

Attachments: remittance_template.csv (text/csv), PO-000487-invoice-sample.pdf (application/pdf)
